title: Tax zones
description: Configure tax rates by country and region.

help.title: About tax zones
help.overview: Tax zones decide the tax added at checkout and the VAT inside till prices. Each zone covers a country, or part of it, and holds one or more rates.

sections.title: Where a zone applies
items: Checkout uses the shipping address; the till uses the address of its first warehouse.
States and postal codes narrow a zone; leave them empty for the whole country. Use * in a postal code, like 10*.
Every active zone that matches applies, highest priority first. An address that matches no zone pays no tax.

sections.title: Rates
items: Each rate has a name, a percentage, and what it applies to: all products, physical only or digital only.
A compound rate is charged on the price plus the taxes before it.
Till prices already include VAT: the tax is worked out from the price, not added on top.
Each order keeps its tax broken down by rate.
